scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && cd apps/identity-generator && npm install
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: npm install --no-save concurrently && concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn discovita.app:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend/apps/identity-generator && PORT=3000 npm start"
scripts.build: cd frontend/apps/identity-generator && npm run build && cd ../../.. && rm -rf backend/public/* && cp -r frontend/apps/identity-generator/build/* backend/public/
